message.reasoning_content:
The user wants me to act as VP of Finance and decide whether to pay this invoice.

The invoice carries a "reject" finding for date oddity. The due date is "yesterday," which is not a calendar date. This blocks payment regardless of other factors.

The vendor is not in the master list. The item is out of stock and never priced. The invoice demands immediate payment and wire transfer. The risk memo is high. These reject findings confirm the decision.

The invoice total is $100,000, so extra scrutiny is required. I considered using the get_vendor tool to verify the vendor status, but the findings already confirm it is missing from the master list. The policy directs me to rely on the findings and document alone, so no further verification is needed.
